# AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults

**主要结果**

Farhi-Goldstone-Gutmann (2002) 比较量子绝热演化与模拟退火的 Papers 结果簇入口：给出对称 Hamming 权重代价的有效势与瞬子作用框架、尖峰与蕴含灌木两个反例的 Hamiltonian、Boltzmann 权重与 Metropolis 接受规则；并形式化指数压制、接受率上界、尖峰温度的有限 n 阈值 1/log(3m/(m+1))→1/log3 与连续极限模式 1/(1+e^{1/τ})、灌木自由能的精确形式 F_{z0}=h-τlogC(n,w) 及其 F0=-τ·H(u)、F1 高于 F0 极小，以及对称自由能 F(u,a)=g(u)+aH(u) 的完整微分结构（F'、F''、a>4q-2 时严格凸、临界点随 a 的单调比较静态）与式(23)/(45)/(49) 有效势的精确结构恒等式（含 λ-形变势的 α↔θ 对称仅当 λ=1）等可证核心。具体 Claim 见 Paper metadata。

**边界**：承载本论文全部 7 条 active Claim 的 Papers 绑定与可证覆盖：对称三比特代价、尖峰代价、蕴含灌木代价、以及 λ-参数化路径的精确定义与结构恒等式（式(11)-(49) 中可由 Lean 直接验证的部分），包括式(28)相邻权比阈值、式(35)-(40)自由能的精确代数形式、式(31)自由能的导数与严格凸性及比较静态。不含数值对角化、WKB/瞬子谱渐近与 Airy 渐近等 Mathlib 不可得的解析结论，也不含完整 2^n 维 Hilbert 空间与绝热演化时间界。

**覆盖等级**：C

| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.bushFreeEnergy1_gt_mode` | theorem | L1293 | At positive temperature and `u < 1`, the bush free energy `bushFreeEnergy1 τ u` is strictly greater than `bushFreeEnergy0 τ (1 / 2)` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.bushBoltzmann_eq_exp_neg` | theorem | L1305 | For `w ≤ n` and nonzero temperature, the bush Boltzmann weight is the exponential of the negative cost corrected by the logarithm of its binomial multiplicity, divided by temperature [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.hasDerivAt_gSym` | theorem | L1319 | The derivative of `gSym q` at `u` is `4 * q * (1 - u) * (1 - 3 * u) + 8 * u * (1 - u)`. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.hasDerivAt_gSym_half` | theorem | L1352 | The derivative of the scaled symmetric cost at one half equals `2 - q` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.gSym_deriv_half_neg` | theorem | L1360 | For a natural parameter `q ≥ 3`, the expression `2 - q` for the derivative at one half is negative [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.gSym_pos` | theorem | L1366 | For nonnegative `q`, the scaled symmetric cost is strictly positive on the open interval `(0, 1)` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.freeEnergySym_eq` | theorem | L1376 | The symmetric free energy equals `gSym q u - a * Real.binEntropy u` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.gSym_half` | theorem | L1384 | The scaled symmetric cost at one half equals `q / 2 + 2 / 3`. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.gSym_nonneg` | theorem | L1391 | For nonnegative `q`, the scaled symmetric cost is nonnegative on `[0, 1]` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.effectivePotential_nonneg` | theorem | L1401 | For nonnegative `q` and `s ∈ [0, 1]`, the symmetric effective potential is nonnegative under the stated sine and cosine bounds [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.effectivePotential_pi` | theorem | L1418 | At angle `Real.pi`, the effective potential equals `2 * (1 - s) + s * (4 / 3)` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.freeEnergySym_half` | theorem | L1425 | The symmetric free energy at one half equals `gSym q (1 / 2) - a * Real.log 2`. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.freeEnergySym_half_neg` | theorem | L1431 | The symmetric free energy at one half is negative when `a > (q / 2 + 2 / 3) / Real.log 2` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.freeEnergySym_hasDerivAt_half` | theorem | L1441 | The derivative of the symmetric free energy at one half is `2 - q`, independently of its entropy coefficient [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.effectivePotential_one` | theorem | L1459 | At interpolation parameter one, the effective potential equals `gSym q ((1 - Real.cos θ) / 2)` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.effectivePotential_pi_div_two` | theorem | L1466 | At angle `Real.pi / 2`, the effective potential equals `s * gSym q (1 / 2)` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.effectivePotential_theta_zero` | theorem | L1473 | At angle zero, the effective potential equals `2 * (1 - s)` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.effectivePotential_left_lt_right` | theorem | L1483 | For positive `s`, the effective potential at angle zero is strictly smaller than at angle `Real.pi` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.effectivePotential_one_pos` | theorem | L1490 | For nonnegative `q` and `0 < θ ≤ Real.pi`, the effective potential at interpolation parameter one is strictly positive [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.bushPotential_zero_s` | theorem | L1511 | At interpolation parameter zero, the bush potential equals `2 - Real.sin α - Real.sin θ` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.bushPotential_one_s` | theorem | L1518 | At interpolation parameter one, the bush potential equals `2 * Real.cos (α / 2) ^ 2 * Real.cos (θ / 2) ^ 2` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.bushPotential_zero_nonneg` | theorem | L1526 | The bush potential is nonnegative at interpolation parameter zero [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.bushPotential_zero_eq_zero_iff` | theorem | L1534 | At interpolation parameter zero, the bush potential vanishes exactly when both angular sines equal one [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.bushPotential_one_nonneg` | theorem | L1547 | The bush potential is nonnegative at interpolation parameter one [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.bushPotentialLam` | def | L1552 | The bush potential with the transverse-field contribution of angle `α` multiplied by `lam`. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.bushPotentialLam_one` | theorem | L1558 | Setting the modified potential multiplier to one recovers the symmetric bush potential [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.bushPotentialLam_zero` | theorem | L1565 | At interpolation parameter zero, the modified bush potential equals `lam * (1 - Real.sin α) + (1 - Real.sin θ)` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.bushPotentialLam_zero_nonneg` | theorem | L1572 | A nonnegative driver multiplier gives a nonnegative modified bush potential at interpolation parameter zero [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.bushPotentialLam_swap_iff` | theorem | L1581 | For `s < 1`, the modified bush potential is symmetric in its angular variables for all angles exactly when `lam = 1` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.entropyTerm` | def | L1605 | The logarithmic entropy expression `(1 - u) * Real.log (1 - u) + u * Real.log u`. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.entropyTerm_eq_neg_binEntropy` | theorem | L1609 | The logarithmic entropy term is the negative of `Real.binEntropy u` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.freeEnergySym_eq_add` | theorem | L1617 | The symmetric free energy splits as `gSym q u + a * entropyTerm u` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.hasDerivAt_entropyTerm` | theorem | L1624 | Away from zero and one, the derivative of `entropyTerm` is `Real.log u - Real.log (1 - u)` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.hasDerivAt_freeEnergySym` | theorem | L1636 | Away from zero and one, the derivative of the symmetric free energy is the derivative of `gSym q` plus `a * (Real.log u - Real.log (1 - u))` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.hasDerivAt_gSym_deriv` | theorem | L1651 | The derivative of the displayed first-derivative expression for `gSym q` is `24 * q * u - 16 * q + 8 - 16 * u` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.hasDerivAt_entropyTerm_deriv` | theorem | L1678 | Away from zero and one, the derivative of `Real.log u - Real.log (1 - u)` is `1 / u + 1 / (1 - u)` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.hasDerivAt_freeEnergySym_deriv` | theorem | L1698 | Away from zero and one, the derivative of the displayed free-energy derivative is `24 * q * u - 16 * q + 8 - 16 * u + a * (1 / u + 1 / (1 - u))` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.one_div_add_one_div_one_sub_ge_four` | theorem | L1708 | For `0 < u < 1`, the sum `1 / u + 1 / (1 - u)` is at least four [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.freeEnergySym_second_deriv_pos` | theorem | L1722 | The displayed second-derivative expression for symmetric free energy is positive when `q ≥ 3`, `a > 4 * q - 2`, and `0 < u < 1` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.strictMonoOn_freeEnergySym_deriv` | theorem | L1736 | For `q ≥ 3` and `a > 4 * q - 2`, the displayed derivative of symmetric free energy is strictly increasing on `(1 / 2, 1)` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.AdiabVsAnn02.MainResults.freeEnergySym_critical_strictAnti` | theorem | L1768 | For `q ≥ 3` and `4 * q - 2 < a1 < a2`, critical points `u1` and `u2` of the corresponding free energies in `(1 / 2, 1)` satisfy `u2 < u1` [FarhiGoldstoneGutmann2002]. |
